issues.where: the star on top of the tree (crop 3; also set-A-02 crop 4, set-A-03 crop 7, set-B-02 crop 4)
issues.what: the star is a flat yellow cutout with uniform fill and hard edges, no thickness, no bevel and no glow bloom, perched on a thin bare stick that does not enter the foliage
issues.fix: model the star with real thickness and a beveled edge, add emissive falloff with a soft halo, and seat its stem into the top branches

issues.where: the icicles on the base rim (crops 8, 9 and 12; identical in set-B-03 crops 8, 9, 12)
issues.what: the icicles are milky opaque white with no light transmission, reading as white plastic or wax rather than clear ice; tips carry no translucent gradient
issues.fix: use a refractive ice material with slight internal scattering, darker cores at the root, bright edge highlights and clear translucent tips

issues.where: the snow-storm streaks across the globe (set-B-02 crops 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)
issues.what: the blizzard is uniform-width curved white streaks, evenly spaced and all equally sharp at one depth, with none out of focus; the cottage stonework smears with the streaks as a flat screen while nothing in the storm blurs at different depths
issues.fix: vary streak width, spacing and opacity, place streak layers at several depths with matching defocus, and keep the smeared interior and the sharp overlay from sharing the same plane

issues.where: the snow pile on the collar (crop 9; also set-B-03 crop 9 and crop 12)
issues.what: the snow carries stamped four-point sparkle star sprites, an additive flare effect rather than granular glints
issues.fix: replace the sprite glints with small specular hits from fine snow grain, varied in size and intensity

issues.where: the dark backdrop behind the globe (crop 9, and set-C-02 crop 5)
issues.what: a faint horizontal band streaks across the dark background gradient behind the glass
issues.fix: even out the backdrop gradient and remove the banding

issues.where: the large snowflakes lying on the surface (crops 11 and 12)
issues.what: the fallen flakes read as flat white decals with crisp uniform edges, no thickness, no wetting at the contact and no reflection in the glossy surface beneath them
issues.fix: give flakes slight thickness and translucency, soften or melt the contact edges, and reflect them faintly in the surface

issues.where: left of the lamp post beside the tree trunk (crop 7)
issues.what: a sharp-edged clump of snow floats in mid-air resting on nothing, near flakes that are out of focus while it stays crisp
issues.fix: remove the floating clump or blur it to match a near-camera flake
